title: Optimal climate policy in incomplete electricity markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.41103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Incomplete long-term contracting in electricity markets can expose investors and consumers to inefficient levels of risk. This paper investigates how incompleteness impacts the optimal choice of climate policy. We develop a game-theoretic model of optimal policy-making in anticipation of how electricity market agents react to a given policy when gas prices and demand are uncertain and contracting is incomplete. In illustrative experiments, we observe that renewable subsidies and carbon prices induce an insurance co-benefit when markets are incomplete. This is because, relative to a complete market benchmark, incompleteness shifts investment from renewables toward gas and exposes consumers to uninsured risk from inter-annual volatility in electricity prices. By incentivizing investment in renewables, subsidies and carbon prices indirectly counteract these distortions. Consequently, incompleteness increases the optimal subsidy and carbon

translated_title: 不完全电力市场中的最优气候政策
translated_abstract: 电力市场中不完整的长期合约安排会使投资者和消费者面临低效率的风险水平。本文研究了市场不完全性如何影响气候政策的最优选择。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，在天然气价格和需求不确定且合约不完整的情形下，预测电力市场参与者对给定政策的反应，从而进行最优政策制定。在说明性实验中，我们观察到当市场不完整时，可再生能源补贴和碳价格会带来一种保险方面的协同效益。这是因为，相对于完全市场基准，市场不完全性会将投资从可再生能源转向天然气，并使消费者面临电力价格年际波动带来的未保险风险。通过激励可再生能源投资，补贴和碳价格间接抵消了这些扭曲。因此，市场不完全性提高了最优的补贴水平和碳价格。
tldr: 本文发现电力市场的不完全性使可再生能源补贴和碳价格具有保险协同效益，从而提高了最优补贴水平和碳价格。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that incompleteness in electricity markets gives renewable subsidies and carbon prices an insurance co-benefit, thereby raising the optimal subsidy level and carbon price.
